assets.prompt:
Create a NEW OpenMotion README companion infographic. The supplied cover is a STYLE REFERENCE, not content to copy. Match this exact visual family: luminous warm ivory paper, broad hand-painted sky-blue and turquoise sweeps, emerald/celadon pigment, small pale-apricot accents, abundant clear central space, rich expressive brush texture around the perimeter, crisp very dark almost-black sans-serif type with bold large editorial headings. Finished flat artwork, wide 2:1 landscape, not a photo of a poster. It must look like the same designer created it beside the cover. Avoid the appearance of a SaaS dashboard or generic flowchart: no grid of rounded pastel cards, no drop shadows, no boxed UI panels, no numbered badges. Use open typographic groups, generous spacing, delicate clean connecting lines/arrows over quiet ivory areas and organic painterly accents. This is a readable architecture diagram, not merely decorative art. All copy must be exact English as supplied below, extremely legible at README scale. Add only a small OpenMotion wordmark. No Coming, is coming, soon, roadmap status, competitor names, other logos, extra slogans or invented tiny text. Opaque background.
Main heading: "Your agent. The whole video stack."
Three open input groups across the upper-middle:
"BYOA" / "Your local agent"
"BYOK" / "Your media accounts"
"Motion Design MD" / "Your brand + creative rules"
Connect these inputs to a single left-to-right creative workflow, using clear arrows and no boxes:
"Understand" → "Code" → "Generate" → "Edit" → "Render"
Below the workflow, supporting line: "HTML / CSS / JS + media"
Small factual line: "Media generation is optional."
Bottom statement in strong type: "Your brand. Your source. Your MP4."
Small footer: "Open-source creation software"
Keep the input-to-workflow relationships clear, with a shared connector feeding the START of the workflow rather than the middle.
assets.connectorEdit: Make ONE precise diagram connector edit to this image. Keep all text, typography, spacing, artwork, colors and layout exactly unchanged. The three upper input groups BYOA, BYOK and Motion Design MD currently merge into a central downward arrow above Generate. Replace ONLY that connecting line system: all three inputs should join a shared thin black horizontal connector and its ONE downward arrow must terminate directly above the first workflow step "Understand" on the left. Keep the left-to-right Understand → Code → Generate → Edit → Render arrows untouched. No central arrow into Generate. The visual meaning must be that the three inputs feed the start of the entire workflow. Preserve the painterly cover style and every other pixel as closely as possible. No new text.
